title: Clarify or pin deferral of launcher carries that cannot earn credit
outcome: V3 review found that launcher_gone, run_missing and ambiguous carries on a non-current held claim enter bounded deferral and say they await settlement, although settlement can only refuse them. They occupy a bounded slot until focus returns or existing TTL. Clarify the holder line or refusal timing and pin the selected behavior without weakening credit safeguards.
acceptance: A regression covers non-current held-claim launcher_gone, run_missing and ambiguous carries and pins their chosen refusal or holder-message behavior.
Holder wording accurately distinguishes a carry awaiting a credit decision from one already known unable to earn credit; no evidence is credited to another claim.
Relevant carried-check tests pass on the changed input.
